Execute: build, create, generate. Output JSON: {mode, intent}' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.rawInput }], stream: false, format: { type: 'object', required: ['mode', 'intent'], properties: { mode: { type: 'string', enum: ['chat', 'execute'] }, intent: { type: 'string' } } }, options: { temperature: 0.1 } } }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'accepted', agent: 'Solution Architect', stage: 'solution-architecture', jobId: $('Create Job')?.first()?.json?.id || 'pending', message: 'Pipeline started', projectSlug: $json.projectSlug } }}

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.name FROM architecture.projects p WHERE p.slug = $1;
SELECT id FROM architecture.jobs WHERE project_id = $1 AND stage = 'architecture' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO architecture.jobs (project_id, stage, input_job_id, status, meta) VALUES ($1, 'solution-architecture', $2, 'running', $3::jsonb) RETURNING id, stage, status;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.type) a.type, a.content FROM architecture.artifacts a WHERE a.project_id = $1 AND a.type IN ('brd', 'business_arch', 'application_arch', 'data_arch', 'infrastructure_arch') ORDER BY a.type, a.version DESC;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = $2) INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, $2, next_version.v, $3::jsonb, $4, $5::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;
UPDATE architecture.jobs SET status = 'completed', completed_at = now() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, status;
